engagement_background.objective: Advantia Health engaged Treya Partners to drive measurable cost savings through strategic sourcing across key spend categories and to establish stronger procurement processes and controls that support long-term operational discipline and private-equity value creation.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Treya will execute savings-creation activities across 10 targeted categories representing roughly $19 M in annual spend (out of ~$45 M total), including Employee Benefits, Medical & Diagnostic Devices, Medical Supplies, Billing/RCM, Telecom, Data Center/Cloud, Office Supplies and others; the work also includes a review of procurement processes/controls. Employee Benefits is an optional work-stream and some suppliers may ultimately be non-addressable after category deep dives.
constraints_challenges: Limited strategic procurement resources and focus within Advantia prior to the engagement
Two separate AP/P-card systems (Advantia Mid-Atlantic and Heartland) with incomplete back-end integration from acquisitions
Insufficient line-item and usage data in internal systems, requiring supplemental data pulls from suppliers
Decentralized, multi-site buying environment that can create supplier relationship sensitivities and change-management hurdles
Tight 4-6-month timeline to deliver savings, with an additional benefits work-stream targeted for completion by October 2022

procurement_environment.data_availability: AP and P-card spend data for Oct-2020 – Sep-2021 were available; contract files and detailed usage data had to be requested from high-spend suppliers.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Spend spread across multiple systems and vendor naming conventions; limited item-level detail and gaps where suppliers did not provide historical usage data.
